anomalies.observed: On the SkylabModule sheet, the microSD card data/command/clock pads are labeled with the same nets as the keyboard matrix columns: J10 pin 2 (DAT3/CD) and U4 pin 7 (COL1) are both NET0003; J10 pin 3 (CMD) and U4 pin 9 (COL2) are both NET0053; J10 pin 5 (CLK) and U4 pin 10 (COL3) are both NET0021; J10 pin 7 (DAT0) and U4 pin 17 (COL4) are both NET0030; J10 pin 8 (DAT1) and U4 pin 19 (COL5) are both NET0033.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes the microSD card as wired to the SKW92A SD_CLK/CMD/D0-D3 pins and the keyboard as a separate 5-column + 7-row matrix scanned by GPIO. SD data/command/clock lines and keyboard column lines should be separate nets.

evidence.quote: SkylabModule sheet: J10 pin 2 DAT3/CD -> NET0003 and U4 pin 7 COL1 -> NET0003; J10 pin 3 CMD -> NET0053 and U4 pin 9 COL2 -> NET0053; J10 pin 5 CLK -> NET0021 and U4 pin 10 COL3 -> NET0021; J10 pin 7 DAT0 -> NET0030 and U4 pin 17 COL4 -> NET0030; J10 pin 8 DAT1 -> NET0033 and U4 pin 19 COL5 -> NET0033.
netlist shows 5 column + 7 row lines wired directly to SKW92A GPIO pins ... microSD ... wired to SKW92A's shared SD_CLK/CMD/D0–D3 pins

anomalies.impact: Pressing keyboard keys would short SD data/command/clock lines together and to the module SD pins, corrupting or preventing microSD access and causing keyboard misreads.

anomalies.observed: The EPD connector pin 14 (SDA/SPI_MOSI) is labeled NET0017. The same NET0017 label is connected to SKW92A pin 17, which is marked GND on the SkylabModule sheet.
anomalies.expected: The specification maps J1.14 (SDA) to SPI_MOSI and to SKW92A pin 12, not to a module ground pin.

evidence.quote: EPD_Driver sheet: J7 pin 14 -> NET0017; SkylabModule sheet: U10 pin 17 GND -> NET0017.

anomalies.impact: The EPD SPI_MOSI line is tied to a ground pin, so the display cannot receive data and the display interface is effectively shorted to ground.

anomalies.observed: The EPD connector pin 13 (SCL/SPI_CLK) is labeled NET0035. The same NET0035 label is connected to SKW92A pin 18, which is marked USB+ on the SkylabModule sheet.
anomalies.expected: The specification maps J1.13 (SCL) to SPI_CLK and to SKW92A pin 11, not to the module USB+ data pin.

evidence.quote: EPD_Driver sheet: J7 pin 13 -> NET0035; SkylabModule sheet: U10 pin 18 USB+ -> NET0035.

anomalies.impact: The EPD SPI clock is merged with the module USB+ pin, preventing normal display operation and interfering with any USB data function.

parsed.summary: The drawing contains label-defined connectivity faults: SD card lines are merged with keyboard column lines, and the EPD SPI clock/data lines are tied to module USB+/GND pins instead of the specified display GPIO/SPI pins.
